
:root{
  --ground:#fffdf6;
  --panel:#f7f1ea;
  --edge:#e7ddd2;
  --ink:#332c26;
  --ink-2:#6d6156;
  --ink-3:#9b8d80;
  --accent:#ff8c8c;
  --accent-ink:#c25b5b;
  --chip:#efe6dc;
  --shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(120,95,70,.07), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(120,95,70,.5);
  --radius:22px;

  /* design spec — locked, these are the Figma values and must not theme-shift */
  --d-board:#fffdf6;
  --d-frame:#f5e6e6;
  --d-grey:#dedede;
  --d-red:#ff8c8c;
  --d-icon:#393939;
  --noise:url("data:image/png;base64,");
  --d-edge:#5e3624;          /* shared border colour across the new design */
  --d-btn-edge:#b7630e;
  --d-btn-mid:#eeae6d;
  --d-btn-face:#cd8842;
  --d-serve-edge:#bc8f18;
  --d-serve-mid:#fff4d7;
  --d-serve-face:#fde6a9;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --ground:#1c1917;
    --panel:#252120;
    --edge:#3a3330;
    --ink:#f3ece4;
    --ink-2:#b7aa9d;
    --ink-3:#8a7d72;
    --chip:#332d2a;
    --accent-ink:#ff9d9d;
    --shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --ground:#1c1917;
  --panel:#252120;
  --edge:#3a3330;
  --ink:#f3ece4;
  --ink-2:#b7aa9d;
  --ink-3:#8a7d72;
  --chip:#332d2a;
  --accent-ink:#ff9d9d;
  --shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--ground);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:Nunito,"Noto Sans TC",system-ui,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,64px) clamp(18px,4vw,40px) 96px}

/* ---------- type ---------- */
h1,h2,h3{text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
.eyebrow{
  font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3);margin:0;
}
h1{font-size:clamp(30px,5.5vw,48px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.15}
h2{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,26px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.lede{color:var(--ink-2);max-width:60ch;margin:0}
.note{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:14.5px;max-width:66ch;margin:0}
.mono{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-feature-settings:"tnum"}

header.top{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-bottom:clamp(28px,5vw,48px)}
section{margin-top:clamp(48px,8vw,88px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.sec-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.stage{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:22px;
  justify-items:center;
}
.pan-card{
  width:min(100%,430px);
  border:5px solid var(--d-edge);
  border-radius:30px;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  background:var(--d-frame);
  line-height:0;
}
.readout{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;
}
.stage-chip{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  padding:7px 15px 8px;border-radius:999px;
  font-weight:800;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.01em;
  background:var(--chip-bg,var(--chip));color:var(--chip-fg,var(--ink-2));
  transition:background .5s linear,color .5s linear;
}
.dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex:none}
.clock{
  font-family:Chango,Nunito,sans-serif;
  font-size:34px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.clock .pre{font-family:Nunito,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--ink-3);text-transform:uppercase;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle}

/* ---------- Buttons (Figma: 217x90 + 5px border, three stacked layers) ---------- */
.pad{width:min(100%,430px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.pad-row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}
.pad-row .pbtn{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}
.pbtn{
  --h:74px;                       /* inner height; 90 in the design */
  --edge:var(--d-btn-edge);
  --mid:var(--d-btn-mid);
  --face:var(--d-btn-face);
  --lbl:18px;
  position:relative;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  height:calc(var(--h) + 10px);
  margin-top:0;
  padding-bottom:calc(var(--h) * 9 / 90);
  appearance:none;cursor:pointer;
  border:5px solid var(--d-edge);
  border-radius:calc(20px + 5px);
  background:var(--edge);
  transition:height .13s ease, margin-top .13s ease, padding-bottom .13s ease, transform .1s ease;
}
.pbtn::before,.pbtn::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;border-radius:20px}
.pbtn::before{height:calc(var(--h) * 84 / 90);background:var(--mid)}
.pbtn::after{height:calc(var(--h) * 81 / 90);background:var(--face)}
/* Hover: the button presses into the counter. Height 90 -> 84 (Figma node
   2704:2770 / 2704:2776), but anchored at the BOTTOM so the top edge sinks 6px.
   Shrinking from the bottom would read as the button lifting instead.
   margin-top makes up the height difference so the layout does not jump. */
.pbtn:hover:not([disabled]){
  height:calc(var(--h) * 84 / 90 + 10px);
  margin-top:calc(var(--h) * 6 / 90);
  padding-bottom:calc(var(--h) * 3 / 90);   /* keeps the label centred on the face layer */
}
.pbtn:active{transform:translateY(3px)}
.pbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-ink);outline-offset:3px}
.pbtn[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:default;filter:none;transform:none}
.pbtn > .grain{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  border-radius:20px;
  background-image:var(--noise);
  background-repeat:repeat;
  background-size:128px 128px;
  mix-blend-mode:overlay;
  opacity:.45;
}
.pbtn-label{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  font-family:Chango,Nunito,sans-serif;
  font-size:var(--lbl);line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:3px;
  color:var(--d-edge);
  text-shadow:
    0 -4px 0 #fff, 1.53px -3.7px 0 #fff, 2.83px -2.83px 0 #fff, 3.7px -1.53px 0 #fff,
    4px 0 0 #fff, 3.7px 1.53px 0 #fff, 2.83px 2.83px 0 #fff, 1.53px 3.7px 0 #fff,
    0 4px 0 #fff, -1.53px 3.7px 0 #fff, -2.83px 2.83px 0 #fff, -3.7px 1.53px 0 #fff,
    -4px 0 0 #fff, -3.7px -1.53px 0 #fff, -2.83px -2.83px 0 #fff, -1.53px -3.7px 0 #fff;
}
.pbtn--serve{
  --edge:var(--d-serve-edge);
  --mid:var(--d-serve-mid);
  --face:var(--d-serve-face);
  --lbl:32px;
}
.crumbs{
  position:absolute;z-index:1;left:0;top:0;width:100%;
  height:calc(var(--h) * 81 / 90);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cutlery{
  filter:url(#fx-cutlery);
  position:absolute;z-index:3;top:50%;
  height:calc(var(--h) * 138 / 90);
  width:auto;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cutlery--fork{left:calc(47px - 23px);transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-10deg)}
.cutlery--knife{right:calc(47px - 18px);transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(10deg)}
/* on hover the cutlery tilts slightly, as if being picked up */
.cutlery{transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.32,.64,1)}
.pbtn:hover .cutlery--fork{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-19deg)}
.pbtn:hover .cutlery--knife{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(19deg)}
.pbtn[disabled]:hover .cutlery--fork{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-10deg)}
.pbtn[disabled]:hover .cutlery--knife{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(10deg)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .cutlery{transition:none}
  .pbtn:hover .cutlery--fork{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-10deg)}
  .pbtn:hover .cutlery--knife{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(10deg)}
}

/* ---------- doneness ramp / scrubber ---------- */
.ramp{width:min(100%,560px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.ramp-mark{
  position:relative;height:15px;
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--accent-ink);
}
.ramp-mark span{position:absolute;left:83.333%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;bottom:0}
.ramp-track{
  position:relative;height:26px;border-radius:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#feefcd 0%,#fedd94 11%,#e9a552 62%,#d57e36 83.3%,#8f5730 91%,#5e3624 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(120,80,40,.16);
  cursor:pointer;
}
.ramp-track:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-ink);outline-offset:3px}
.ramp-perfect{
  position:absolute;top:-5px;bottom:-5px;left:83.333%;width:2px;
  background:rgba(60,40,25,.42);border-radius:2px;
}
.playhead{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;
  width:20px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  background:var(--ground);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ink) inset, 0 4px 10px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.ramp-legend{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--ink-3);
}
.speed{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3);
}
.speed-group{display:inline-flex;background:var(--chip);border-radius:999px;padding:3px}
.sp-btn{
  appearance:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;
  font:inherit;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink-3);
  padding:5px 13px;border-radius:999px;
  transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease;
}
.sp-btn:hover{color:var(--ink-2)}
.sp-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink);outline-offset:2px}
.sp-btn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ground);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.speed em{font-style:normal}
.ramp-legend b{font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-ink)}

/* ---------- state grid ---------- */
.states{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));
  gap:clamp(14px,2.5vw,24px);
}
.state{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.state figure{margin:0;border:5px solid var(--d-edge);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:var(--d-frame);line-height:0}
.state h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:800}
.state .meta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.5}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2px}
.sw{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-2);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.sw i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}

/* ---------- board ---------- */
.board{
  border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  background:var(--d-board);line-height:0;
}

/* ---------- spec table ---------- */
.specs{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:520px;font-size:14px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:9px 14px 9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);vertical-align:top}
th{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3)}
td.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
code{
  font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12.5px;
  background:var(--chip);padding:1.5px 6px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink-2);
}

footer{margin-top:clamp(48px,8vw,80px);padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge);color:var(--ink-3);font-size:13px}

/* ---------- Dial ---------- */
.dial{opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.pan-card:hover .dial,
.pan-card.is-setting .dial{opacity:1}
.pan-card.is-served .dial{opacity:0}
.pan-card.is-served .grip{display:none}
.grip{cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.grip:active{cursor:grabbing}
.grip:focus-visible{fill:rgba(194,91,91,.10);stroke:var(--accent-ink);stroke-width:3;outline:none}
.dial-hint{
  font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3);text-align:center;margin:0;
  transition:color .2s ease;
}
.dial-hint b{color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:800}

/* ---------- Grain (matched against the grain in the Figma export) ---------- */
.grainy{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.grainy::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  border-radius:inherit;
  background-image:var(--noise);
  background-repeat:repeat;
  background-size:128px 128px;
  mix-blend-mode:overlay;
  opacity:.6;
}

/* ---------- svg pan internals ---------- */
.cake{
  font-family:Chango,Nunito,sans-serif;
  font-size:70px;
  text-anchor:middle;
  dominant-baseline:central;
  paint-order:stroke;
  stroke-linejoin:round;
}
.cake-outer{stroke-width:11}   /* batter edge; measured at about 5.5px */
/* Shadow: Figma uses a weight-10 OUTSIDE stroke. SVG only has centred
   strokes, but since the pancake covers this layer completely, drawing it
   at 20 puts the full 10px outside. */
.cake-shade-wrap{opacity:.5}
.cake-shade{stroke-width:20;transform:translateY(2px)}
.cake-inner{stroke-width:6}    /* the inner highlight ring */
.padlabel{
  font-family:Chango,Nunito,sans-serif;
  text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;
  letter-spacing:3px;paint-order:stroke;stroke-linejoin:round;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .btn{transition:none}
}
